notes.title: Devlog #4 – What’s New in Corner Shop: Nightshift
notes.content: [h1]Watch the video![/h1][previewyoutube="oH3WBJbh3DI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]We’ve got a lot of exciting updates we’ve been working on recently:[/p][p]🎰 [b]Casino[/b] – the much-anticipated feature is finally here![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/6f1f5c749ddc40f30b330e66b57dabf6caa036a2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]💊 [b]Medicine & Coffee[/b] – now you can restore your [i]mental health[/i] with medicine, and when the night shift starts to drain your energy, a hot cup of coffee will keep you going.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/d1192b383c067030885406a95bce91e058cff383.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🧽 [b]Store Cleanliness[/b] – we’ve reworked the dirt & stain system. The cleaner your shop, the better tips you’ll receive from customers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/e948e920f9820bda65d1388cbcfce4befe92303c.jpg"][/img][/p][p] 🛍️ [b]Bagging System[/b] – based on your feedback, we’ve added an extra step: now you’ll need to hand customers a shopping bag at the checkout.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/6a7ac5310ff7498daf834ad6d97077a6c2f9b799.jpg"][/img][/p][p] 📦 [b]Parcels[/b] – customers can now come in with pick-up slips. It’s your job to hand out the correct package and verify the tracking number.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/c43c0b71510154d5a3bc83d442d1bfdea52714e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And this is just part of what’s coming – we’re continuing to make the night shift more immersive (and unpredictable 😉).[/p][p]Let us know in the comments what you think of these new systems and which one you’re most excited about![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/29032e3fa78e4dbbef3556e94c52666fb3c65e8b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: 🎰 [b]Casino[/b] – the much-anticipated feature is finally here!
💊 [b]Medicine & Coffee[/b] – now you can restore your [i]mental health[/i] with medicine, and when the night shift starts to drain your energy, a hot cup of coffee will keep you going.
🧽 [b]Store Cleanliness[/b] – we’ve reworked the dirt & stain system. The cleaner your shop, the better tips you’ll receive from customers.
🛍️ [b]Bagging System[/b] – based on your feedback, we’ve added an extra step: now you’ll need to hand customers a shopping bag at the checkout.
📦 [b]Parcels[/b] – customers can now come in with pick-up slips. It’s your job to hand out the correct package and verify the tracking number.

notes.title: Demo Update & Devlog #3
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
First of all — huge thanks to everyone who played the [i]Corner Shop: NightShift[/i] demo and sent in feedback. We’ve been reading it all, and many of the changes in this patch come directly from your suggestions. [/p][previewyoutube="eRZc2R9Z18I;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h2]📦 UPDATE – Version 0.7.15.47[/h2][h3]🧩 Gameplay & Mechanics[/h3][list][*][p]Refactored quest system and whiteboard — quests now switch language instantly without delay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New mechanic:[/b] some NPCs may arrive with [b]invalid ID photos[/b] — the player can detect and react accordingly.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved NPC age randomization to better match their appearance.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted player movement speed in specific areas for balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved interaction logic and fixed hidden dirt cleaning issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed trash objects not colliding with the mop.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]visual indicators[/b] for blocked phone apps.[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue system improvements — new dialogue options added.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined horror sequences and scripted events for better clarity and timing.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎮 UI & UX[/h3][list][*][p]Pause menu improvements, including resolution scale setting at game start.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mouse sensitivity setting[/b] added for improved comfort.[/p][/*][*][p]Better widget focus handling and keyboard navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed calendar format for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved notepad and navigation widgets.[/p][/*][*][p]Bank app UI rework.[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual indicators for blocked apps in the phone UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization issues and added missing translations.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated phone and flashlight textures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed language change behavior in quests and menus.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔊 Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Improved audio attenuation for products and store speakers.[/p][/*][*][p]Added concurrency limit for UI sounds to avoid clutter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed voice-over timing in horror sequences.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced loading screen music volume.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎨 Visuals & Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Optimized textures for better performance (resolution adjustments where appropriate).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted field of view during certain sequences for better immersion.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lighting and shadow casting in multiple areas.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📓 DEVLOG #3 – What’s Next?[/h2][p]We’ve seen your feedback about the horror layer of the game — and we agree: it can go further.
We’re working on new ways to unsettle you, blending psychological tension with physical threats.[/p][p]Here’s an early look at something in development:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/0230319967ce6e3e4510855eaa623309a89f2651.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This entity moves through ceiling vents, its tangled, cable-like form weaving in and out of shadows.
Is it just a schizophrenic hallucination of our protagonist’s fractured mind?
Or is it a real creature, hunting you from above?
We’re not saying — you’ll have to discover that yourself.[/p][p]This is [b]not[/b] in the current demo — it’s part of ongoing development inspired by your feedback. Expect more creatures, more psychological twists, and more moments where you won’t be sure what’s real.[/p][hr][/hr][p]💬 Let us know what you think of the update in the comments.
📌 Don’t forget to [b]wishlist[/b] the game to get notified about future updates and the full release![/p]
